'''Hideo Mabuchi''' (born 1971) is a [[physicist]] and Professor of Applied Physics at [[Stanford University]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://minty.stanford.edu/hmabuchi/ |title=Hideo Mabuchi |access-date=2010-04-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100722130922/http://minty.stanford.edu/hmabuchi/ |archive-date=2010-07-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and the head of the Mabuchi Lab.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://minty.stanford.edu/people/ |title=MabuchiLab People |access-date=2010-04-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100722122440/http://minty.stanford.edu/people/ |archive-date=2010-07-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He graduated from [[Princeton University]] ''magna cum laude'', with an A.B. in Physics in 1992, and from
[[California Institute of Technology]] (Caltech) with a Ph.D. in Physics, in 1998, where he studied with [[H. Jeff Kimble]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://minty.stanford.edu/hmabuchi/fullcv.pdf |title=Curriculum vita |access-date=2010-04-30 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100722215341/http://minty.stanford.edu/hmabuchi/fullcv.pdf |archive-date=2010-07-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

He was a professor at Caltech from 1998 to 2007 (Assistant Professor of Physics, 1998–2001; Associate Professor of Physics and Control & Dynamical Systems, 2001–2007).<ref name=CV>{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vita |url=https://cap.stanford.edu/profiles/viewCV?facultyId=9185&name=Hideo_Mabuchi |website=Community Academic Profile (CAP) Network |access-date=9 March 2023 |date=September 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Hideo Mabuchi |url=http://www.its.caltech.edu/~hmabuchi/ |website=Information Technology Services |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000819013743/http://www.its.caltech.edu/~hmabuchi/ |archive-date=19 August 2000}}</ref> Since 2007, he is a Professor of Applied Physics and Modern Thought and Literature (MTL) at Stanford.
